validation.error_message: aws_region must be a region identifier such as us-east-1.
cluster_arn must be the ARN of an ECS cluster.

cluster_arn.description: ARN of the ECS cluster to deploy into

validation.condition: ${length(var.subnet_ids) > 0 && alltrue([for id in var.subnet_ids : can(regex("^subnet-", id))])}
validation.error_message: subnet_ids must be a non-empty list of subnet IDs.

subnet_ids.description: IDs of the subnets tasks are placed in

validation.condition: ${length(var.security_group_ids) > 0 && alltrue([for id in var.security_group_ids : can(regex("^sg-", id))])}
validation.error_message: security_group_ids must be a non-empty list of security group IDs.

security_group_ids.description: IDs of the security groups tasks join

validation.error_message: vpc_id must be the ID of a VPC, such as vpc-0a1b2c3d.

vpc_id.description: ID of the VPC the Cloud Map namespace is created in

task_role_name.description: Name of the IAM role this stack creates for its tasks

execution_role_name.description: Name of the IAM role this stack creates for the ECS agent to pull images and write logs
